checks.lead: Zhao Jiande (Chinese: 趙建德; pinyin: Zhào Jiàndé; Jyutping: Ziu6 Gin3 Dak1, Vietnamese: Triệu Kiến Đức, ?–111 BC) was the last king of Nanyue. His rule began in 112 BC and ended in the next year. He was executed by Western Han forces during the reign of Emperor Wu of Han.
